Name: Short Grass
Author: Freakycrafter
Description:
With the addition of the new grass in 1.6 the grass mod I was using didn't work properly anymore (white bars instead of the new grass), so I decided to make my own!



I'm not good at spriting, let alone making art, so I mostly just removed part of the top bottom and sides of the existing stardew valley sprites and realigned then, so it wouldn't look like the grass is just... floating.


Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Smapi[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
